mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_gw_service_edge (src_service, dst_service, window_start, calls, errors, total_cost, max_cost, update_time) SELECT service_name, peer_service, #{windowStart}, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0), COALESCE(MAX(cost), 0), NOW() FROM tb_gw_trace_span WHERE kind = 'CLIENT' AND peer_service IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= #{windowStart} AND start_time < DATE_ADD(#{windowStart}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY service_name, peer_service ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE calls = VALUES(calls), errors = VALUES(errors), total_cost = VALUES(total_cost), max_cost = VALUES(max_cost), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT src_service AS src, dst_service AS dst, SUM(calls) AS calls, SUM(errors) AS errors, CASE WHEN SUM(calls) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(total_cost) / SUM(calls)) ELSE 0 END AS avgCost, MAX(max_cost) AS maxCost FROM tb_gw_service_edge WHERE window_start >= #{since} GROUP BY src_service, dst_service ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT trace_id AS traceId, MIN(start_time) AS startTime, COUNT(*) AS spanCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errorCount, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, MIN(start_time), MAX(DATE_ADD(start_time, INTERVAL cost * 1000 MICROSECOND))) / 1000) AS totalCost FROM tb_gw_trace_span WHERE start_time >= #{since} GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY totalCost DESC LIMIT #{limit}
